process.title: Tell us the day
process.text: Your date, venue, guest count and whether it is a full or a mini sadhya.

process.title: Fix the menu
process.text: Choose the curries and payasams; we suggest the right spread for the occasion.

process.title: Set the stage
process.text: Nilavilakku, uruli, nirapara and flowers, arranged before the guests arrive.

process.title: Cook fresh
process.text: Everything is cooked fresh on the day — pure vegetarian, start to finish.

process.title: Serve in rows
process.text: Our crew serves on banana leaf, row by row, and keeps the payasam coming.

aboutBody: {fullName} is based in {place}. We cook pure-vegetarian Kerala sadhya — from a simple Mini Sadhya to the full banana-leaf feast with two or three payasams — for weddings, choroonu, housewarmings, Onam and temple functions. Alongside the food we set the traditional stage: lit nilavilakku, flower-filled uruli and nirapara, so the whole day feels like home.
